Definition: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsavvâʼr, meaning the back of the neck. It appears 38 times in Scripture, including Genesis 27:40 and Isaiah 10:27.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsavvâʼr matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
